faq.q: How long does a boat transfer from Marbella to Sotogrande take?
faq.a: The cruise from Puerto Banús to Sotogrande Marina takes approximately 50 minutes. Depending on sea conditions and boat speed, it can be as quick as 40 minutes on a planing hull like the Azimut 39 or Astondoa 40.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a golf transfer to Sotogrande?
faq.a: For small groups, the Astondoa 40 (9 pax) or Azimut 39 (11 pax) are ideal at €749/2h. For larger parties up to 12 guests, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719 minimum 4h) offers extra space and includes a free jet ski.

faq.q: Can I bring my golf clubs on the boat?
faq.a: Yes. There is ample storage on all our boats for golf bags, shoes, and trolleys. We recommend a soft travel cover to protect clubs during the 50-minute crossing.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras.

faq.q: Do I need to arrange my own transport from Sotogrande Marina to the golf club?
faq.a: The marina is about 10 minutes by taxi from Real Club de Golf Sotogrande. We can help arrange a pre-booked taxi or you can walk (approx. 25 min). Sotogrande also has a chauffeured buggy service for guests.

faq.q: Can I combine the transfer with a round of golf and return later?
faq.a: Absolutely. Many golfers book a 6- or 8-hour charter, cruise to Sotogrande, play their round, and then enjoy the return trip with drinks and sunset views. Contact us via WhatsApp for a custom itinerary.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for golf transfers?
faq.a: We require 48 hours' notice for a full refund. Within 48 hours, we try to reschedule if possible. Weather cancellations are fully refundable or can be moved to another date.

data.body_html:
Combine your next round at Real Club de Golf Sotogrande with a luxury boat transfer from Marbella. Depart Puerto Banús, cruise the Costa del Sol in under an hour, and arrive at Sotogrande Marina ready to tee off. No traffic, no parking stress — just a cold drink, sea air, and a direct water route to one of Europe's finest golf destinations. Our Marbella boat rental service makes it simple, with all-inclusive pricing from €749 for two hours.

Why take a boat to Sotogrande Golf?

Driving from Marbella to Sotogrande takes roughly 40 minutes on the AP-7, but parking near the club can be tight. A boat transfer turns the journey into part of the experience. You'll leave from Puerto Banús, pass Cabopino and Cala del Faro, and arrive at the marina a short taxi ride from the course. The 50-minute crossing is smooth, scenic, and includes complimentary drinks and snacks. For groups of 4–9, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 are ideal — both cost €749 for a 2-hour charter, which covers the transfer and a little extra time for photos or a short cruise back.

Our recommended boats for golf transfers

Choose based on group size. For up to 9 guests, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are the most cost-effective options at €749/2h. Both have a comfortable saloon and outdoor seating for your golf bags. For larger groups up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m) offers a faster, more spacious ride at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour booking — includes a jet ski for post-golf fun. All boats depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. No hidden fees.

What’s included in your charter

Every booking comes with a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT. You don't need to worry about anything — just bring your clubs, sunscreen, and a good mood. The skipper will navigate, point out landmarks like La Concha mountain and the Marbella coastline, and ensure a safe, enjoyable trip. For a full list of available boats, see our Marbella boat rental fleet.

Sotogrande: a golfer’s paradise

Real Club de Golf Sotogrande is a 18-hole championship course designed by Robert Trent Jones Sr., consistently ranked among Europe's top 100. It's a 10-minute taxi from the marina. The area also offers Valderrama (5 minutes away) and La Reserva. Many golfers book a full-day charter: cruise over at 9am, play 18 holes, then return by 5pm for sunset drinks on the water. That's a 6- or 8-hour charter — contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

How to book your Sotogrande golf transfer

Reserve your boat online or message us on WhatsApp. We'll confirm availability within 2 hours. Payment is via bank transfer or card. For the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, the 2-hour rate covers the transfer one-way; for a round trip, book a 4-hour charter (€1,498). The Mangusta 80 requires a minimum 4-hour booking (€4,719) and includes a jet ski. All prices include VAT. Browse our full fleet or contact us directly.

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras.
